name: Paragraph Spell Focus
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds native spelling focus for the active paragraph.
Adds Pro section scope and saved folder rules.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The plugin settings now end with a More from NoteMods card. You can turn this tab off there.
tip: Assign a hotkey to Toggle paragraph spelling focus in Obsidian to switch focus on and off while you write.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Paragraph Spell Focus is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for writing with it.
